mapper.select: select id, reservation_id, strategy_id, award_id, lock_surplus, status, create_time, update_time from strategy_award_stock_decrement_ledger where reservation_id = #{reservationId} limit 1

select id, reservation_id, strategy_id, award_id, lock_surplus, status, create_time, update_time from strategy_award_stock_decrement_ledger where strategy_id = #{strategyId} and award_id = #{awardId} and status = 'reserved' order by create_time asc

select id, reservation_id, strategy_id, award_id, lock_surplus, status, create_time, update_time from strategy_award_stock_decrement_ledger where status = 'reserved' order by create_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update strategy_award_stock_decrement_ledger set lock_surplus = #{lockSurplus}, update_time = now() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status = 'reserved' and lock_surplus is null
update strategy_award_stock_decrement_ledger set status = 'applied', update_time = now() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status = 'reserved'
update strategy_award_stock_decrement_ledger set status = 'released', update_time = now() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status in ('reserved', 'applied')
